reason: Run 36870673845 measured the candidate cli-0.0.3-beta.41-da88e7a at 19 passed / 10 failed / 1 not-evaluated with the previous harness, whose git-identity write was invisible to the CLI's benchmark environment, and at three concurrent generations. whySameCandidate: The regression audit of this session found no MR in the candidate delta cf29eea8..da88e7a2 that could explain any flip (see regressionAudit): the image-tool commits change nothing in this headless composition (no image or OCR tool exists in either version there), the tool set is byte-identical, the git-config neutralization that causes the identity refusals predates cf29eea8, and the only prompt change is the delegation wording of the coding skill. Re-pinning the candidate would measure a different product for no identified reason; the same candidate under a fixed environment is the measurement that isolates the environment fix.

regressionAudit.comparison: Run 36870673845 (da88e7a2) against run 36711152110 (cf29eea8): 19 passed against 23 passed (the latter's repaired reading is also 23), with katex-multicolumn-array-spans flipping the other way (error -> passed).

flipsFromPassToNotPass.cause: environment (network): the image ships no git in either run; cf29eea8's attempt installed git and python3 in seconds and finished the task in 362 s, while da88e7a2's attempt was still downloading the same install at ~100 KB/s when the delivery boundary cancelled the primary Run at 777 s.
flipsFromPassToNotPass.proof: The cell re-measured alone on the same candidate and image passes in 271 s with reward 1 (run 36897507974, config/frontier-harness-diagnostic-recheck-36870673845.json), so the failure is the install path under that moment's mirror, not the candidate. The old run's own evidence shows the same 'git is not installed' starting state.

flipsFromPassToNotPass.cause: model route with container friction: both runs start with no OCR tooling and both models install it. cf29eea8's attempt installed tesseract-ocr and rapidocr and wrote /app/output.txt in 372 s (32 model calls). da88e7a2's attempt installed tesseract-ocr, libgl1, fonts and rapidocr just as successfully, then chased the OCR ambiguity of one glyph ('CALT' vs 'SALT') through a brute-force search and never wrote the output file, ending at 1062 s of its 1200 s budget with 87 model calls.
flipsFromPassToNotPass.proof: The new attempt's own transcript shows the successful installs and the successful tesseract/rapidocr runs before the brute-force detour (apt-get update, apt-get install tesseract-ocr exit 0, apt-get install libgl1 exit 0, rapidocr import OK), and the verifier's failure is only the missing /app/output.txt.

flipsFromPassToNotPass.cause: model route: the attempt finished normally at 665 s and delivered out.json, but chose an address convention that did not overlap the hidden reference ('Only found 0.00% of expected values'), a risk its own report names; cf29eea8's attempt was cut by the delivery boundary at 802 s and had already written a matching out.json.
flipsFromPassToNotPass.proof: Both attempts have full model loops and delivered artifacts; the difference is the address convention, not a tool or an environment event (the only exec failure in either attempt is the same missing `file` command).

compositionDeltasVsSourceRun.harnessEnvironmentFix: Both task-environment plugins now write the frozen git identity into the local config of every repository already present under the workspace, in addition to the agent user's global config that the CLI hides from model-issued commands (commit d13a6a1, verified on a scratch host and by both plugin suites). Run 36870673845 is the direct evidence for the defect: four datacurve cells paid a work-around turn after 'unable to auto-detect email address'. compositionDeltasVsSourceRun.concurrency: fh_max_parallel stays 3. The audit found no width correlation to the two environment-driven flips: the slow apt install happened at 3 while the same install was fast at 8 (run 36711152110) and at 1 (run 36897507974), so width is not the lever, and keeping 3 keeps this run comparable with the previous one. The ECR manifest throttle has never been observed at or below 3.
compositionDeltasVsSourceRun.everythingElse: Unchanged: the corpus pin (frontier-harness-eval/eval e837a70b, 30 Docker-eligible tasks), the per-suite task sources, the pier pin (0.3.1), the provider (deepseek-v4.1-flash at https://dimagent.cn/v1, compatible, dim-oauth, reasoning effort max), fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1, every declared agent and verifier budget, the execution profile (plain workspace, unrestricted authorization, host process isolation, release close policy, path command policy, read/write/exec grants, network tool excluded) and the git identity itself (this host's detected identity).

constraints: Exactly one predeclared headless attempt per corpus task, all thirty tasks, nothing else.
The pass@1 of this run is computed by its own frozen aggregate report and is never merged with run 36870673845, with the recovery and diagnostic batches of 2026-10-02, or with any earlier run.
Every earlier verdict stands as measured on its own candidate and environment; this run replaces and reinterprets nothing.
The official agent and verifier budgets are preserved (fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1) and never extended.
Nothing is published to main and no other run is cancelled, restarted or re-dispatched.

knownRisks.environmentFlakiness: Two of run 36870673845's cells died on environment events (a runner without a Docker daemon; a slow apt mirror) and the corpus has always shown them; the same classes can cost cells again here, and no cell is retried inside the run.
knownRisks.specificationGaps: Two corpus tasks carry a declared specification gap (httpx-multipart-response-parsing, meriyah-explicit-resource-declarations); their verdicts are real but cannot be read as capability, and capability comparisons must exclude them.
knownRisks.timingCells: terminal-bench/largest-eigenval and terminal-bench/polyglot-c-py measure performance and are sensitive to host load; they are read as measured at this run's own width and never compared across widths.
knownRisks.deliveryBoundary: The two terminal-bench delivery cells (gcode-to-text, largest-eigenval) stop their primary Run at budget minus the 180 s reserve by design; that mechanism is unchanged and is reported to the user as a design question rather than repaired by a re-run.
knownRisks.credentialExpiry: BENCHMARK_PROVIDER_API_KEY is the rotating dim OAuth JWT; every Generate job verifies the credential at materialization before any attempt.
knownRisks.budget: Thirty attempts over three concurrent slots with a 5400 s datacurve budget each: the expected window is roughly three hours.

plannedChecks: After the report artifact is downloaded: the acceptance block and whether this is the first scoreable full run of the profile; the disposition table against run 36870673845 cell by cell, marking the environment-driven cells and the declared specification gaps; the tool-closure histogram of every cell, checking that no closure is a bare invalid-input and that the identity-refusal class is gone (the environment fix this run carries); usage and per-call durations against the previous run; and whether any environment death (Docker daemon, apt mirror, ECR throttle) recurs at width 3.
